# المستلزمات — Requirements: ماذا تحتاج كل قدرة وماذا يفتح كل تثبيت

<!-- generated by scripts/requirements.py index; edit data/requirements.json and the records, then regenerate -->

لكل قدرة في الكتالوج حقل `requires` يسمّي ما تحتاجه قبل أن تعمل: أداة على المسار، حزمة pip أو npm، مفتاح أو حساب، منصة، خطوط، نموذج. هذا الفهرس يقلب العلاقة: لكل مستلزم، كم قدرة يفتح وأي عائلات وأمر التثبيت. `python3 $SKILL_DIR/scripts/requirements.py for <ID>` يعطي قائمة قدرة واحدة، و`plan "<المهمة>"` يجمع مستلزمات مهمة كاملة مع ما هو حاضر الآن. — Every power carries `requires`; this index inverts it: for each requirement, how many powers it unlocks, their families and the install command. Presence here is read-only detection, not proof of quality.

<a id="requirements"></a>
## المستلزمات / requirements

<a id="req-python3"></a>
### `python3` — تشغيل سكربتات المهارة / run the skill's scripts

- **النوع / kind:** bin (أداة)
- **التثبيت / install:** `apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip python3-venv`
- **يفتح / unlocks:** 802 powers
- **بالحالة / by status:** proven 299 · documented 212 · ready 169 · install 106 · key 13 · seen 3
- **العائلات / families:** runnable-tools (136), engines-render-pipeline (97), qa-verification (79), mental-models (61), music-beat-sound (45), app-feature-transfer (27), atlas-code (24), photo-video-footage (16)
- **أمثلة / examples:** `ANLY-08` statsmodels OLS and time-series models · `ANLY-14` altair / Vega-Lite chart specs · `ANLY-17` Gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM) · `ANLY-21` Convex optimisation with cvxpy · `ANLY-23` Graph algorithms with networkx · `APP-06` HTML to MP4 renderer (repo tool)

<a id="req-npm-hyperframes"></a>
### `npm:hyperframes` — مُصيِّر HTML قابل للبحث الزمني مع مكونات / seekable-DOM HTML renderer with components

- **النوع / kind:** npm (حزمة npm)
- **التثبيت / install:** `npm i -D hyperframes@0.8.164  (Apache-2.0; some components load GSAP from a CDN)`
- **يفتح / unlocks:** 461 powers
- **بالحالة / by status:** install 368 · documented 26 · proven 22 · ready 16 · key 14 · seen 13 · idea 2
- **العائلات / families:** transitions-cuts (112), engines-render-pipeline (88), camera-composition-layout (35), typography-latin (26), qa-verification (24), ui-product-device (23), light-glow-bloom (19), charts-data-infographic (11)
- **أمثلة / examples:** `ARAB-02` RTL scoping for renderers · `ARAB-06` Shaping-engine routing · `EASE-30` Spring pop entrance · `ENG-01` HyperFrames composition contract · `ENG-32` Dual-engine shim (HyperFrames or studio renderer · `ENG-33` Step-to-skill map

<a id="req-ffmpeg"></a>
### `ffmpeg` — قص ودمج وترميز وضبط علوّ الصوت وحرق الترجمات واستخراج الإطارات / cut, concat, transcode, loudnorm, burn captions, extract frames/audio

- **النوع / kind:** bin (أداة)
- **التثبيت / install:** `apt-get install -y ffmpeg  (or: conda install ffmpeg)`
- **يفتح / unlocks:** 459 powers
- **بالحالة / by status:** documented 158 · proven 149 · ready 71 · install 58 · key 10 · seen 9 · idea 4
- **العائلات / families:** engines-render-pipeline (68), qa-verification (63), transitions-cuts (54), music-beat-sound (49), runnable-tools (41), app-feature-transfer (27), photo-video-footage (22), color-palette-grading (15)
- **أمثلة / examples:** `APPX-01` Speed curve (ramp) · `APPX-02` Chroma key · `APPX-03` Auto reframe to 9:16 · `APPX-04` Scene edit detection · `APPX-05` Loudness normalisation (-14 LUFS) · `APPX-06` Colour look from a .cube LUT

<a id="req-chromium"></a>

- **التثبيت / install:** `npm i playwright && npx playwright install chromium  (cloud: pre-installed at /opt/pw-browsers)`

- **بالحالة / by status:** proven 120 · install 115 · documented 102 · ready 27 · key 6 · idea 2 · seen 1

- **أمثلة / examples:** `APP-05` Phone-viewport screenshot + overflow check · `APP-06` HTML to MP4 renderer (repo tool) · `APPX-31` Dehaze (ClearView-style) · `APPX-32` Tiered noise reduction · `APPX-33` Auto keystone / perspective · `APPX-34` Lens distortion correction
